proposals.rule: Short UI command labels (buttons, links, menu items, toggles and setting labels) use the 2nd-person singular imperative, e.g. "Obnovi podatke", "Posodobi", "Omogoči". This is the normal form for labels and does not break the formal register, so do not flag it. It also applies when running text quotes a button label: the quote must match the label's actual wording (e.g. "Obnovi podatke"), not a formal "Obnovite …" header. Still flag: full sentences, descriptions and messages addressed to the user that use informal ti-forms instead of the formal vi-forms, and quoted label text that differs from the referenced label string.
